name: Unscroll
subtitle: Instagram without the endless scroll
description:
Instagram without the endless scroll: no Reels, no Explore, no suggested posts — just the people you follow, their stories, and your DMs. Unscroll is Instagram's own website with those taken out, made to feel like an app.

Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Meta or Instagram.

versions.localizedDescription: • Unscroll 1.9.1: the chat's camera no longer sits on "Message..."

• Unscroll 1.9.0: a camera in the chat, and photos from the phone's photo picker
• Unscroll 1.8.13: a message's whole menu, found however Instagram shows it
• Unscroll 1.8.12: holding your own message shows its whole menu, once
• Unscroll 1.8.11: Home is the Following feed again
• Unscroll 1.8.10: over the feed, the keyboard slides the page up instead of shrinking it
• Unscroll 1.8.9: a push to the feed's own address no longer reloads it; a keyboard that closes by itself is reported
• Unscroll 1.8.8: sharing a post, its search keeps the keyboard
• Ignore Kotlin's build state (.kotlin/), and untrack a compiler log committed by mistake
• Unscroll 1.8.7: holding a message shows Instagram's whole menu for it at once
• Unscroll 1.8.6: a chat's reactions open from the bubble only; its notices follow Settings
• Unscroll 1.8.5: a gesture on a sheet or a post opened over a page stays there
• Unscroll 1.8.4: holding a reel opened from a chat pauses it, not the message behind
• Unscroll 1.8.3: reels kept out of the feed's streamed answers too; the bar's rules leave posts alone
• Unscroll 1.8.2: reels kept out of the feed's data, so posts stop vanishing as you swipe a carousel
• Unscroll 1.8.1: a bug sweep (docs/BUG_SWEEP.md): page changes move on every iPhone, back closes a chat's menu
• Unscroll 1.8.0: Settings holds choices, not how it feels; every page change animates
• Unscroll 1.7.12: posts drawn again at the top of the feed stay in sight
• Unscroll 1.7.11: the post you're reading stays put; hold a reel for 2×, pinch a photo to zoom
